name: list_codex_models
description: List models, supported reasoning efforts and context windows from the installed Codex CLI. Catalog errors are returned directly.

refresh.description: Bypass the cache and re-read the catalog from the CLI.

working_dir.description: Absolute directory to read the catalog in. A project you have trusted in Codex can set its own catalog, so pass the directory a delegation would use. Defaults to this server's own.
